title: Precise terms and a need for recognition

captions.physics: Separating actual promises from assigned expectations
captions.energy: Finding joint answers to concrete questions

meaning: You can find terms honestly while noticing when a strong need for recognition begins directing conversation about a particular promise.
text: A precise disagreement about a promise can carry more feeling than its subject. Justice in the physical position of Vishuddha distinguishes actual words from expectations assigned to another. The Chariot in energy supports a joint answer to a concrete question. The Devil in emotions holds tightly to recognition of personal importance. Clarified terms can stand beside a strong desire for a particular reaction. An honest reply can establish what was promised without removing every disappointment, leaving the feeling its own words.

For example, a joint message remains unsent because each assumed the other was handling it. You check whether the commitment was actually spoken. **A clear solution leaves recognition its own subject.** An action can be chosen now alongside acknowledging a feeling that responsibility always falls to one person. That experience need not become a proved account of every earlier occasion. Present commitment and wanting to be noticed can receive separate honest replies.

The difficulty is clarifying until the other confirms an entire personal version of the past. A concrete matter is settled while conversation still demands who participates more. Naming support separately preserves honest terms. A decision can be shared without someone declaring permanent indebtedness merely to restore outward calm.
